name: Burton Cummings Theatre
scope: The former Walker Theatre at 364 Smith Street in Winnipeg as the Burton Cummings Theatre in July 2014. It includes the three-storey ornamental limestone entrance, marquee, attached unadorned brick auditorium and fly tower.

references.filename: Burton Cummings Theatre in Winnipeg, Manitoba.jpg

originalReview.notes: The 2014 photograph shows the long black-edged white marquee, small lower wall frames, dark green entrance, vertical green sign and the plain buff brick auditorium wall.
